exposure: Lack of education and advice about optimal breastfeeding postures
outcome: Musculoskeletal pain (lower back, neck, shoulder, hand pain)
Limitation of activities of daily living
cohort: The study included 493 nursing mothers in Jordan who had breastfed their babies for 6 months or more following normal delivery.
finding: Nursing mothers in Jordan reported experiencing musculoskeletal pain, attributed to breastfeeding, that interfered with daily activities and quality of life, largely due to not receiving appropriate education or advice about optimal breastfeeding postures from health professionals.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single point in time from nursing mothers who had breastfed their babies for 6 months or more, retrospectively exploring their experiences with breastfeeding-related musculoskeletal pain and education.
